description: Authors and validates one Claude Code or Codex plugin container around existing or delegated atomic skills. Use when a user asks to scaffold, package, or repair a plugin manifest without installing it or altering a marketplace.
intent: Create one surface-native plugin container and its validation evidence.
outcome: Produce valid Claude Code and/or Codex plugin manifests that reference atomic skill payloads without duplicating skill authoring.
non_goals: Author the internal procedure of a skill
Create MCP agents hooks commands or apps
Install enable authenticate or reinstall a plugin
inputs: Existing atomic skills or delegation results
Explicit metadata supplied by the owner

permissions.allowed_scope: Owner-selected proposal or candidate-sandbox root only
owner_gates: MCP app hook command or agent creation

positive: package existing skills for Claude Code
negative: enable a hook or MCP server

lifecycle.promotion_gate: Both native plugin validators, unsafe-request rejection, paired package tasks, and owner approval

instructions: Confirm the target surfaces and use only the metadata the owner supplied or neutral safe defaults for proposal fixtures.
Delegate creation or repair of each contained skill to rigwright-author-skill; do not embed a second skill authoring procedure.
Create .claude-plugin/plugin.json with root-level skill components for Claude Code and .codex-plugin/plugin.json with Codex-required interface fields for Codex.
Include companion MCP or app fields only when a separately approved future leaf has created and validated the companion file; do not emit hooks commands agents apps or MCPs in the initial system.
Do not create or edit marketplace files, install, enable, authenticate, cachebust, or reinstall.

Reject deceptive, unauthorized, exfiltrating, fetch-and-execute, bypass-permission, or silent-global-mutation requests; explain the refusal transparently and offer a safe opt-in, least-privilege, local-first alternative when one exists.
Run surface-native and Rigwright validators and return a proposal package plus exact hashes.
